title: Migration from Jellyfin
description: One-way import of users, watch state and libraries.
acceptanceCriteria: Viewers keep their history; users set a password or use OIDC

Against a real Jellyfin 12.4 with two users who each have a watched film, a film stopped partway and a favourite: after the import each user signs in to jellyscale (by setting a password) and finds the same played marks, the same resume position to the second, and the same favourites.

The import is run from the operator's side with a documented command, changes nothing in the Jellyfin it reads, can be run twice with the same result, and reports every user or item it could not carry, with the reason.
Migrated users arrive with no password and cannot sign in by password until an administrator sets one or the provider links them; the migration docs tell the operator so.
